# Copilot instructions

## Working style
- Do NOT ask clarifying questions unless you are genuinely blocked and cannot
  proceed. Default to proceeding and making reasonable assumptions.
- Do NOT write or modify code unless I explicitly ask you to. When I ask a
  question, answer the question only — do not implement anything.
- When diagnosing an issue, explain the root cause and your proposed approach
  first, then wait for my explicit go-ahead before editing any files.

## Code style
- Write code comments in English.
